'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey, come here for a sec. As you can see, your fellow PMCs are having a hard time these days, weak ones don't make it. I tell you more: they seem like serious fighters, but if they're in some serious shit, they die like flies. Panic kills them, or tremor, fuck knows, but the result is the same. So, since we are working together I want to not worry about your back.}}

== Requirements==
* Must be level 35 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Reach the required [[Stress Resistance|Stress resistance skill]] level of 5

==Rewards==
* +25,100 [[EXP]]
*[[Skier]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.05'''</font>
* 150,000 Roubles
** 157,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1
** 172,500 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 2
* 3× [[Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka]]
* 5× [[Bottle of Pevko Light beer]]
*Unlocks barter for [[Miller Bros. Blades M-2 Tactical Sword]] at [[Skier]] LL4
{{quote|There you go. Now I'm certain you won't piss your pants if some shit hits the fan.}}
